profile.dividendPolicy:
The Company has a policy to pay dividends at a rate of not less than 30 percent of the net profit after the deduction of all types of reserves as specified in the laws and regulations of the Company. The dividend payout must not have a significant impact on the Company's normal operations.
However, such dividend payment is subject to change, depending on necessity and other appropriateness in accordance with the Company's performance, financial position, liquidity, investment plans, and other considerations deemed appropriate by the Board of Directors. Notwithstanding, the annual dividend payment must be approved by the shareholders meeting, except it is an interim dividend payment. The Board of Directors may approve the interim dividends from time to time when it deems that the Company has sufficient profits to do so, and then must report such interim dividend payment to the next shareholders meeting.
